title: Revisiting pre-trained remote sensing model benchmarks: resizing and normalization matters
mechanism: Mismatched input size and normalisation hide pretrained features; once matched, ImageNet stays a strong baseline.
adaptation: Benchmark rule: fine-tune each backbone at its pretraining scale and normalisation, map 1-ch EL to the backbone's 3-ch statistics, always include the ImageNet row.
evidence: R: +32.28 points So2Sat, +11.16 EuroSAT from matching preprocessing.
